title: Discontinuing Hope for A Better Life
subtitle: What if giving up all hope was a press release from a tech company?
body_html:
We've made the difficult decision to gradually wind down Hope for A Better Life in February 2025 as the program hasn’t caught on as we’d—ironically—hoped. We are grateful for the humans who have participated in life and its vicissitudes, hoping, now in vain, for it to get a little better. We remain committed to experimenting and testing new ideas to deliver unique and delightful experiences for those damned to labor and toil.

As we bring the program to a close, we want to give both the tortured and their tormentors the opportunity to finish lives they have started. Between now and December 4th, the miserable will be able to continue to add new travails to their existing lives, however, we will no longer accept new hope or dreams. Starting December 4th, the living will no longer be able to add new hope to their day, and their tormentors will no longer be able to sell them on new hopes. Those who strove will be able to continue to use remaining dreams to persevere in the stories and challenges until the program closes in February 2025. In November, we will announce our last bonus for striving that took place in October, and as always, tormentors will continue to earn 50% of what sufferers earn on their toils used to unlock their endlessly trapped lives until we wind down the program in February 2025.


We recommend that you keep your hope alive so that those toiling can complete the lives they’ve started. We also encourage you to continue your stories as fictitious sub-stacks, videos, or other content. We have updated our content guidelines so that you may republish your. Hopes immediately as an eBook. On November 4th, we will make it possible for you of your lives so they are easier to republish as eBooks!

When Hope and Dreams close in February 2025, we will remove all remaining hope. After this, you will be able to access any of their unlocked dreams from the free apps on iOS and Android. You do not need to take any action to remove your dreams or hopes in the meantime. If you would like to stop hoping earlier, we will provide a self-service “no hope” option on December 4th, 2024 so that you’ll be able to end this farce once and for all without Customer Service support.

We will continue to post updates to the Community to remind you of these dates and inform you when the download and hopeless features become available.

Regards,
The Hopes and Dreams Team
